query:
SELECT 
  u.id as user_id,
  u.name as user_name,
  u.email,
  u.loginMethod,
  u.createdAt as user_created,
  u.lastSignedIn,
  COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) as total_projects,
  SUM(CASE WHEN p.status = 'approved' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as approved_projects,
  SUM(CASE WHEN p.status = 'processing' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as processing_projects,
  SUM(CASE WHEN p.status = 'draft' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as draft_projects
FROM users u
LEFT JOIN projects p ON u.id = p.userId
GROUP BY u.id, u.name, u.email, u.loginMethod, u.createdAt, u.lastSignedIn
ORDER BY u.lastSignedIn DESC;
